sloka: अनुकूलम् तु सा भर्तुर् ज्ञात्वा गमनम् आत्मनः ।क्षिप्रम् प्रमुदिता देवी दातुम् एव उपचक्रमे ॥२-३०-४६॥
transliteration: anukūlam tu sā bhartur jñātvā gamanam ātmanaḥ ।kṣipram pramuditā devī dātum eva upacakrame ॥2-30-46॥

translations.english: Having come to know that her departure to the forest is acceptable to her husband, Sita, highly delighted, quickly got ready to give away (things).
